project.title: 18S rRNA gene V9 region amplicon sequencing of protists in NYC environmental samples
project.description: We used amplicon sequencing of the 18S rRNA marker gene V9 region to characterize microbial eukaryotic communities across NYC environments including: raw sewage (collected over a 12 month period from 14 treatment plants in all five NYC boroughs), soil from parks and green spaces, storm water, and sediment.
